title: High CPU Saturation & Process Starvation
root_causes: Unbounded thread execution or runaway infinite loop in business logic
JVM GC pause overhead due to undersized heap or frequent full GC
Cryptographic handshake bottlenecks under sudden spike traffic
immediate_actions: Capture thread dump using jstack: jstack <pid> > thread_dump.txt
Identify threads consuming CPU using top -H -p <pid>
Scale application instances horizontally to distribute compute load
Enable rate limiting at ingress gateway to throttle abusive callers
long_term_fix: Profile hot paths using Async-Profiler; optimize algorithms and adjust GC configuration to G1GC/ZGC with explicit pause targets.

title: Memory Leak & Heap Exhaustion Mitigation
symptoms: Memory usage climbing linearly without post-GC recovery
root_causes: Static collections holding unevicted cache references or session state
ThreadLocal storage not cleaned up in thread pool workers
Undersized maximum heap allocation (-Xmx) for growing workload
immediate_actions: Trigger JVM heap dump using jcmd <pid> GC.heap_dump /tmp/heap.hprof
Perform rolling restart of unhealthy instances to restore headroom
Temporarily divert 50% traffic to standby replica nodes
long_term_fix: Analyze heap dump with Eclipse Memory Analyzer (MAT); eliminate memory retention in static maps and configure bounded caches with TTL.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion & Query Latency
symptoms: Connection acquisition timeout from HikariCP pool
root_causes: Long-running unindexed queries holding database connections open
Transaction boundary wrapping slow remote REST/RPC calls
Database locks or deadlocks waiting on uncommitted transactions
immediate_actions: Check active PostgreSQL queries: SELECT pid, now() - query_start AS duration, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle' ORDER BY duration DESC;
Terminate blocking queries using SELECT pg_terminate_backend(<pid>);
Increase HikariCP maximumPoolSize if PostgreSQL max_connections permits
long_term_fix: Add appropriate B-tree or partial indexes; refactor service methods to exclude external network calls from @Transactional boundaries.

title: Elevated Error Rate & Downstream Service Failure
symptoms: Circuit breaker state transitions to OPEN
root_causes: Dependent third-party payment or authentication API unreachable
Schema mismatch or serialization error following a canary deployment
Network partition or DNS resolution failures across availability zones
immediate_actions: Inspect application error logs for root exception class and stack trace
Engage circuit breaker fallback mechanisms to gracefully degrade non-critical features
If issue followed a recent release, initiate immediate rollback to last known good build
long_term_fix: Implement resilient exponential backoff with jitter on HTTP clients; configure distributed caching for degraded read operations.

title: Cascading Service Failure & Dependency Throttling
symptoms: Upstream timeouts cascading to edge routers
root_causes: Single-point-of-failure database or cache node degradation causing upstream backlog
Lack of bulkheading between critical operational and background batch tasks
Unbounded message queue retry queue clogging consumer workers
immediate_actions: Pause background batch processing and non-critical scheduled tasks
Enable upstream shed-load policies (HTTP 429) on non-priority traffic
Isolate failing dependency and activate local cached stubs
long_term_fix: Architect strict service bulkheads, enforce deadline propagation (gRPC/HTTP headers), and configure dead-letter queues.
